```{r figure-6-A, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

source("config.local.R")

.libPaths(c(
  r_lib_path_44,
  "/nfs/sw/easybuild/software/R/4.4.1-gfbf-2023b/lib/R/library"
))

# ============================================================
# Reproduce Plot 2, Plot 3, and the combined figure
# from the saved trait_locus_master table
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)


paths <- paths_figure6

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_file <- paths$trait_locus_master

output_dir <- paths$output_dir

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Optional trait labels
# Example:
# trait_labels <- c(
#   "IBD" = "Inflammatory bowel disease"
# )

trait_labels <- character(0)

label_trait <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    !!!trait_labels,
    .default = x
  )
}

# Use your original palette here if it is already defined.
# Otherwise, these colors make the script self-contained.
qtl_cmap_coloc <- c(
  "just_eqtl"  = "#C7197C",
  "just_caqtl" = "#9CCB86",
  "both"       = "#0071BA"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load the canonical saved data frame
# ------------------------------------------------------------

trait_locus_master <- readr::read_csv(
  master_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_columns <- c(
  "trait",
  "region",
  "cs_index",
  "region_cs",
  "eqtl_coloc",
  "caqtl_coloc",
  "has_cbpnet_gwas_cs",
  "has_cbpnet_qtl_cs"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(trait_locus_master)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The master table is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# read_csv() should normally read these correctly, but this protects
# against logical columns being stored as text.
to_logical <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(x)
  }

  tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c(
    "true",
    "t",
    "1",
    "yes"
  )
}

trait_locus_master <- trait_locus_master %>%
  mutate(
    eqtl_coloc = to_logical(eqtl_coloc),
    caqtl_coloc = to_logical(caqtl_coloc),
    has_cbpnet_gwas_cs = to_logical(has_cbpnet_gwas_cs),
    has_cbpnet_qtl_cs = to_logical(has_cbpnet_qtl_cs),

    qtl_coloc_cs = eqtl_coloc | caqtl_coloc,

    qtl_coloc_category = case_when(
      eqtl_coloc & caqtl_coloc  ~ "both",
      eqtl_coloc & !caqtl_coloc ~ "just_eqtl",
      !eqtl_coloc & caqtl_coloc ~ "just_caqtl",
      TRUE                      ~ "no_coloc"
    ),

    has_cbpnet_either_cs =
      has_cbpnet_gwas_cs | has_cbpnet_qtl_cs,

    cbpnet_category = case_when(
      qtl_coloc_cs & has_cbpnet_either_cs ~
        "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet",

      !qtl_coloc_cs & has_cbpnet_gwas_cs ~
        "ChromBPNet_specific",

      qtl_coloc_cs & !has_cbpnet_either_cs ~
        "QTL_coloc_no_ChromBPNet",

      TRUE ~
        "Neither"
    )
  )

# Confirm that each row is one unique trait–GWAS CS locus.
duplicate_loci <- trait_locus_master %>%
  dplyr::count(
    trait,
    region,
    cs_index,
    region_cs
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_loci) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The master table contains duplicated trait–GWAS loci."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Create summaries used by the plots
# ============================================================

coloc_table_summary <- trait_locus_master %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cond_indep = n(),

    just_eqtl = sum(
      qtl_coloc_category == "just_eqtl",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    just_caqtl = sum(
      qtl_coloc_category == "just_caqtl",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    both = sum(
      qtl_coloc_category == "both",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trait_label = label_trait(trait),
    total_coloc = just_eqtl + just_caqtl + both,

    frac_coloc = if_else(
      total_cond_indep > 0,
      total_coloc / total_cond_indep,
      0
    )
  )


trait_summary <- trait_locus_master %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cs_all = n(),

    cs_with_cbpnet_support = sum(
      has_cbpnet_either_cs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    cs_cbpnet_specific = sum(
      cbpnet_category == "ChromBPNet_specific",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    cs_qtl_coloc_with_cbpnet = sum(
      cbpnet_category == "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trait_label = label_trait(trait),

    prop_cs_with_cbpnet_support = if_else(
      total_cs_all > 0,
      cs_with_cbpnet_support / total_cs_all,
      0
    )
  )

# Display only traits with at least one QTL-colocalized locus.
keep_traits <- coloc_table_summary %>%
  filter(total_coloc > 0) %>%
  pull(trait)

coloc_table_summary_plot <- coloc_table_summary %>%
  filter(trait %in% keep_traits)

trait_summary_plot <- trait_summary %>%
  filter(trait %in% keep_traits)

# Use the same ordering in both panels.
trait_order <- coloc_table_summary_plot %>%
  arrange(
    total_cond_indep,
    trait_label
  ) %>%
  pull(trait_label)

# ============================================================
# Plot 2: QTL–GWAS colocalization
# ============================================================

plot2_df <- coloc_table_summary_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    trait,
    trait_label,
    total_cond_indep,
    just_eqtl,
    just_caqtl,
    both
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      just_eqtl,
      just_caqtl,
      both
    ),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = if_else(
      total_cond_indep > 0,
      count / total_cond_indep,
      0
    ),

    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "just_eqtl",
        "just_caqtl",
        "both"
      )
    ),

    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_order
    )
  )


plot2_total_loci <- coloc_table_summary_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    trait_label,
    total_cond_indep
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(total_cond_indep)


max_total_loci <- max(
  plot2_total_loci$total_cond_indep,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

scaling_factor_coloc <- ifelse(
  max_total_loci > 0,
  1 / max_total_loci,
  1
)


plot2 <- ggplot(
  plot2_df,
  aes(
    x = trait_label,
    y = proportion,
    fill = category
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = plot2_df %>%
      filter(count > 0),
    aes(label = count),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot2_total_loci,
    aes(
      x = trait_label,
      y = total_cond_indep * scaling_factor_coloc,
      group = 1
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot2_total_loci,
    aes(
      x = trait_label,
      y = total_cond_indep * scaling_factor_coloc
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "gray30",
    size = 4,
    stroke = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = qtl_cmap_coloc,
    labels = c(
      "just_eqtl" = "eQTL only",
      "just_caqtl" = "caQTL only",
      "both" = "eQTL + caQTL"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0.01, 0),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name = paste0(
      "Proportion of unique GWAS loci ",
      "colocalized with QTLs"
    ),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / scaling_factor_coloc,
      breaks = pretty(
        c(0, max_total_loci)
      ),
      name = "Total unique GWAS loci per trait"
    )
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Summary of QTL–GWAS colocalization",
    x = "GWAS trait"
  ) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "gray50"
    ),
    axis.title.x.top = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "gray50"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Plot 3: ChromBPNet support
# ============================================================

plot3_df <- trait_summary_plot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    trait,
    trait_label,
    total_cs_all,
    cs_cbpnet_specific,
    cs_qtl_coloc_with_cbpnet
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      cs_cbpnet_specific,
      cs_qtl_coloc_with_cbpnet
    ),
    names_to = "cbpnet_cat",
    values_to = "cs_n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cbpnet_cat = recode(
      cbpnet_cat,
      cs_cbpnet_specific =
        "ChromBPNet_specific",
      cs_qtl_coloc_with_cbpnet =
        "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet"
    ),

    cbpnet_cat = factor(
      cbpnet_cat,
      levels = c(
        "ChromBPNet_specific",
        "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet"
      )
    ),

    prop = if_else(
      total_cs_all > 0,
      cs_n / total_cs_all,
      0
    ),

    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_order
    )
  )


plot3_labels <- trait_summary_plot %>%
  filter(cs_with_cbpnet_support > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_order
    )
  )


plot3 <- ggplot(
  plot3_df,
  aes(
    x = trait_label,
    y = prop,
    fill = cbpnet_cat
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = plot3_labels,
    aes(
      x = trait_label,
      y = prop_cs_with_cbpnet_support / 2,
      label = cs_with_cbpnet_support
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "ChromBPNet_specific" = "#0071BA",
      "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet" = "#F7D58B"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "ChromBPNet_specific" =
        "ChromBPNet only",

      "QTL_coloc_with_ChromBPNet" =
        "ChromBPNet + QTL colocalization"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.30),
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      0.30,
      0.05
    ),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0.01, 0),
    name = paste0(
      "Proportion of unique GWAS loci ",
      "with ChromBPNet support"
    )
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

# ============================================================
# Plot 4: Combined figure
# ============================================================

plot2_compact <- plot2 +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 2,
      b = 5,
      l = 5
    )
  )

plot3_compact <- plot3 +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 5,
      b = 5,
      l = 2
    )
  )


combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plot2_compact,
  plot3_compact,
  nrow = 1,
  align = "h",
  axis = "tb",
  rel_widths = c(2, 0.5)
)

# Display all three plot objects
plot2
plot3
combined_plot



```
